goodsServices.description: Property development services; development of land, buildings, properties, housing and real estate; building construction and demolition services; supervision of buildings during construction and demolition; on-site building project management services; civil engineering; fire-proofing, water-proofing and insulating of buildings during construction; cable laying, carpentry, electrical wiring services, glazing, masonry, painting and decorating of the exterior parts of properties, buildings, houses and offices, pipe-fitting and laying, plastering, plumbing, riveting, roofing and scaffolding erection; repair, renovation, restoration, refurbishment and decoration of the exterior parts of properties, buildings, houses and offices; maintenance and servicing of properties, buildings, houses and offices; cleaning of properties and buildings; the provision, installation and maintenance of street lighting and lighting for business and residential areas; construction, maintenance, cleaning and repair of roads, drainage systems, lifts, pipelines, telecommunication, heating and lighting and environmental control systems; installation and repair of alarm systems including fire and security alarms; public works; information, advice and consultancy services relating thereto; none of the aforesaid relating to interior decorating or interior refurbishment.

Architectural services; architectural services relating to the development of land; design services relating to the exterior parts of residential properties; planning services; services for the planning of residential communities, shopping centres, catering establishments, hotels, buildings, building estates, offices, public facilities and car parks; design services relating to the exterior parts of residential properties; space planning relating to the exterior parts of residential properties, buildings, houses and offices; urban design and planning; building inspection services; surveying services; safety evaluations; information, advisory and consultancy services relating to the aforesaid services; none of the aforesaid relating to interior design.
